title: Chirp
text: Generate swept-frequency cosine (chirp) signal, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Frequency sweep} sets Type of frequency sweep; {Sweep mode}, {Initial frequency (Hz)}, {Target frequency (Hz)}, {Target time (s)} sets the target time of sweep, {Sweep time (s)}, {Initial phase (rad)} sets the initial phase of cosine output, {Sample time} sets the output sample period, {Samples per frame} and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Frequency sweep
params.values: Type of frequency sweep Linear (default) | Swept cosine | Logarithmic | Quadratic

params.name: Initial phase (rad)
params.values: Initial phase of cosine output 0 (default) | scalar
